user.title: Connect Alcedo NVR
user.description: Usually the Alcedo NVR app is found automatically. For manual setup open the app's web UI → 'Connection for the integration' and copy host and API key.

hassio_confirm.title: Alcedo NVR found
hassio_confirm.description: The Alcedo NVR app is running. Connect it to Home Assistant?

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the Alcedo NVR app.

init.title: Hand-over to pCloud Sync
init.description: Finished events (clip and snapshot) can be uploaded automatically with the [pCloud Sync]({pcloud_url}) integration. pCloud Sync installed: {pcloud_status}

data_description.pcloud_subfolder: Below the pCloud Sync target folder; a folder per camera is added.
data_description.pcloud_mode: Confirmed = only alarms the local AI confirmed (or all camera alarms if the AI is off).

trigger.name: Trigger alarm
trigger.description: Starts (or extends) an event on Alcedo cameras, e.g. from a Ring motion or doorbell sensor. Cameras with recording 'on_demand' start recording now.

label.name: Label
label.description: Reason, e.g. motion, person or doorbell.

create_timelapse.name: Create timelapse
create_timelapse.description: Builds a timelapse video of all events in the period (clips sped up, captions with camera, time and AI description). Returns the file path, e.g. to upload it with pCloud Sync.
